source: Explicit synthetic independent L1 pump and L2 lighting feeder paths. Each has its own return; lengths and full single-phase mV/A/m coefficients are assumed scenario data, not surveyed routes or manufacturer cable values. No shared-neutral coupling or three-phase load flow is represented.
return_path_basis: dedicated per-radial return paths; no shared-neutral coupling

L1.source: Explicit synthetic complete origin-to-pump-board feeder plus original branch; no added diversity or factor of two.

feeders.source: Synthetic 20 m dedicated-return single-phase feeder and full 4 mV/A/m coefficient, not product or measured data.

L2.source: Explicit synthetic complete origin-to-lighting-board feeder plus original branch; no added diversity or factor of two.

feeders.source: Synthetic 20 m dedicated-return single-phase feeder and full 4 mV/A/m coefficient, not product or measured data.
